Metadata.title: Rewrity
Metadata.description: Edit your text so it reads like a person wrote it. You review every change.

Home.title: Rewrity
Home.tagline: Paste a text. Rewrity marks stock phrases, filler and stiff constructions and suggests plainer wording. You decide on every change.
Home.headline: A second pair of eyes for your writing.
Home.demoOriginal: In today's fast-paced world, it is crucial to understand that effective communication plays a pivotal role in fostering meaningful connections.
Home.demoReason: Drops the stock opener and the inflated wording.
Home.sourcesTitle: Where the style references come from
Home.sourcesBody: Public-domain books and essays, historical newspapers, and recent news and magazine articles (up to 2022, before AI-written text flooded the web). Excerpts stay on our server; you only see who they came from.

Editor.label: Your text
Editor.placeholder: Paste or type your text here...
Editor.tooLong: This text is too long. The limit is {max} characters.
Editor.exampleText: In today's fast-paced world, it is crucial to understand that effective communication plays a pivotal role in fostering meaningful connections. Moreover, it is important to note that listening is not just a skill, but a journey. In conclusion, by embracing these principles, we can unlock our full potential.

strengthHint.standard: Clear tells, and weaker ones when they pile up.
strengthHint.thorough: Weaker tells and flat phrasing too.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: What this site stores and who sees your text.
Privacy.data: Your email address, and for each rewrite the original text, the suggested edits and the date. Other users cannot read them, and you can delete any entry from the history page.
Privacy.ai: Your text is sent to Anthropic (Claude) to produce the suggestions. Do not submit text you are not allowed to share.
Privacy.limits: Suggestions are style edits. They do not change who wrote a text, and this tool does not detect AI-written text.
